description.value: At 3rd level, and every three levels thereafter, a paladin can select one blessing. Each blessing adds an effect to the paladin's lay on hands ability. Whenever the paladin uses lay on hands to heal damage to one target, the target also receives the additional effects from all of the blessings possessed by the paladin. At 3rd level, initial blessings include Blinded, Deceived, Fatigued, Poisoned, Shaken, and Sickened. At 6th level, additional blessings become available: Dazed, Diseased, Enfeebled, Imperiled, Silenced, and Staggered. At 9th level, additional blessings become available: Confused, Cursed, Exhausted (requires Fatigued), Frightened (requires Shaken), Immobilized, Injured, Nauseated (requires Sickened), Restorative (requires Enfeebled), Sapped (requires Poisoned), and Slowed. At 12th level, additional blessings become available: Amputated (requires Injured), Berserk, Deafened, Disabled, Ensorcelled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Stunned, and Zombie. These abilities are cumulative. Once a status effect or spell effect is chosen, it can't be changed.
